sections.text: مقدمة

In different plants, the HGC suspension ring was found to break off during 
 operation. For this reason, the suspension ring in newly manufactured HGC's 
 (at the vane carrier end) was widened. With installation of reconditioned HGC, 
 the suspension of groove of the vane carrier needs widening form 23 mm to 27 
 mm.

This document initiated by eng. Magdi Sami Ebrahim, tested by 
 eng. Maher Abd Elgwad Salem and eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Ahmed, and approved by 
 eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abdel Ghafar: general director.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

sections.text:
أدوات 
والمعدات
Vertical Lathe
Welding electrodes UTP 7114 diameter 2.5mm.

Welding 
 electrodes Oerliken diameter 2.5mm
العمل الذي يتعين القيام به

Bolting 
 together vane carrier upper and lower half - measure roundness and if 
 necessary reset roundness by using bracings to be installed in blade grooves.

Build up 
 welding according dwg HTCZ 300 068 P 2, views (C) and (D) and remark 3 
 electrodes to be used oerlikon spezil, diameter 2.5 mm no heat treatment required 
 either beforehand or afterwards.

Rework at 
 GT-vane-carrier according dwg.HTCZ300 068. The groove is to widen from 23mm to 
 27mm. The for hard facing planned pockets need to be made on both sides. 
 Positioning, number and size of them pockets to see on dwg. HTCZ300 068 view 
 "A" and "B". This work is to perform local on a vertical turning mill in 
 suitable work shop.

Apply hard 
 facing according dwg. HTCZ300 068 P3 views "A" and "B" in the pockets of sides 
 of the groove. Turning the groove on hard faced sections to the final 
 dimension according dwg. HTCZ 300 068 (consider remarks on dwg.). Electrodes 
 to be used for hard facing UTP7114 dia.2.5mm.No heat treatment required either 
 beforehand or afterwards.
